title: GUARD (fixed in 44a3b4841c) — was: M-t (transpose-words) at end of line panics zshrs at zle_word.rs:1422

retired.fix_commit_subject: zle: port the SIGWINCH redraw, printfmt's % escapes + erase-to-EOL, M-t's NUL-terminator read, and insert_positions' second cline_str walk
retired.why: zle: … item 4 — C reads the slot at zlell legitimately: zleline is over-allocated by two cells (zle_main.c:1287, zle_utils.c:88-89) and every mutator NUL-terminates it (zle_utils.c:820), and c:666-668 restarts its backward scan at zlecs, which IS zlell at end of line. Restoring the terminator fixes the wrong transposition too.
retired.evidence: re-verified first-hand by scripts/compsys_regressions.py under --variants: the fixture cell scored NOW-PASSES -> NOW-PASSES -> NOW-PASSES, and every variant and control of it came back n/a (no variants or controls). The runner reported the binary MOVED since the stamp (6420c23cecc13c35 -> 723088f811cdd366), which is the 'somebody fixed the bug' branch of the two the README names, not the 'the fixture was wrong' one.
retired.kept_because: a fixed bug is worth more as a guard than as a deleted file: the cell stays in the evidence base and the gate now FAILS if the divergence comes back.

observed_when_diverging.crash: thread 'main' panicked at src/ported/zle/zle_word.rs:1422:48: index out of bounds: the len is 17 but the index is 17
observed_when_diverging.notes: The completer in the fixture is never reached: the buffer is a plain `ls` command line and ESC-t is transpose-words. The buffer is 17 bytes, which is the index the panic reports. Reproduced outside the harness too, on a bare `target/debug/zshrs --zsh -f -i` with ZDOTDIR unset: type the buffer, send \x1bt, the process dies. No zstyle is involved — the combo_5_0_e0 reproducer this came from carried one, and it is not needed.
